visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long brown hair, wearing a black T-shirt with a white cat graphic in the pocket, stands against a plain grey wall. She speaks directly to the camera, using her hands to emphasize points. Lighting is bright and even. (2) The scene cuts to a brightly lit classroom. A woman with blonde hair, identified as a teacher, wears a blue dress and holds a marker while gesturing toward students. A girl in the foreground has her head resting on her hands. (3) The scene shifts to a medical setting. A healthcare worker wearing a blue scrub top, a medical mask, and a plastic face shield is visible in a close-up, looking down and interacting with someone out of frame. (4) Return to the woman in the black T-shirt against the grey wall. She continues her explanation, gesturing with both hands. Large white text overlays appear on both sides of her head, highlighting keywords like 'fake smile'. (5) A close-up of another woman appears. She is wearing a professional blue jacket and a headset with a microphone, smiling warmly while speaking, suggesting a customer service environment. (6) The final phase shows the main speaker again. She smiles, gestures toward the cat graphic on her pocket, and pulls out a small white card with the same cat design to reveal a hidden heart, adding a lighthearted ending.
